resources.string: Optional key routing while Radio+ is visible.

If the stock radio receives your buttons, enable Radio+ steering-wheel buttons in Android Accessibility settings. This optional service handles next, previous and mute/play keys only while Radio+ is visible. It does not read screen content or handle typed text. Other apps and volume up/down are not controlled. Keys intercepted inside the car firmware cannot be redirected this way. On Android 13, you may first need to allow restricted settings in the app info menu. Enable this only while parked.
